headline: Google Fi adds automatic carrier switching with a second 5G network
summary: Google Fi announced a 'Super Network' feature that automatically switches between carriers for better speed and reception, adding support for a second 5G network beyond T-Mobile, though Google won't say which carrier. It rolls out first on Pixel phones, which also get a bonus Wi-Fi upgrade, before wider availability in 2027.
